verses.en: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.pt: O ancião, ao amado Gaio, a quem amo em verdade.
verses.en_web: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.en_bbe: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved Gaius, for whom I have true love.

verses.en: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.pt: Amado, eu desejo que estejas bem em todas as coisas, e que tenhas saúde, assim como bem está a tua alma.
verses.en_web: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.

verses.en: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
verses.pt: Pois muito me alegrei quando irmãos chegaram, e testemunharam da tua verdade, como tu andas na verdade.
verses.en_web: For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
verses.en_bbe: For it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.

verses.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.pt: Não tenho maior alegria do que esta: a de ouvir que meus filhos andam na verdade.
verses.en_web: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.
verses.en_bbe: I have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.

verses.en: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.pt: Amado, tu ages fielmente em tudo o que fazes aos irmãos, inclusive aos forasteiros.
verses.en_web: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;

verses.en: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
verses.pt: Estes, diante da igreja, testemunharam do teu amor; aos quais, tu agirás bem ao supri-los de modo digno da vontade de Deus.
verses.en_web: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
verses.en_bbe: Who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of God:

verses.en: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.pt: Pois foi por causa do Nome dele que partiram em jornada, sem nada aceitar dos gentios.
verses.en_web: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
verses.en_bbe: For they went out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

verses.en: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
verses.pt: Portanto devemos acolher tais pessoas, para que sejamos cooperadores da verdade.
verses.en_web: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
verses.en_bbe: So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.

verses.en: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.pt: Eu tenho escrito aos da igreja; porém Diótrefes, que busca ser o comandante deles, não nos recebe.
verses.en_web: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
verses.en_bbe: I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.

verses.en: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
verses.pt: Por isso, se eu vier, trarei à memória os seus feitos, falando ele contra nós com palavras maliciosas; e não satisfeito com isso, não recebe aos irmãos, proíbe aos que se dispõem a fazer, e os expulsa da igreja.
verses.en_web: Therefore if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: So if I come, I will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.

verses.en: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.pt: Amado, não imites o mal, mas sim o bem. Quem faz o bem é de Deus, mas quem faz o mal nunca viu Deus.
verses.en_web: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God: he who does evil has not seen God.

verses.en: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
verses.pt: Demétrio tem alcançado bom testemunho de todos, inclusive da própria verdade. Também nós damos testemunho, e vós sabeis que o nosso testemunho é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.en_bbe: Demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.

verses.en: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
verses.pt: Eu tinha muitas coisas para escrever, porém não quero escrever a ti sobre elas com tinta e pena;
verses.en_web: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
verses.en_bbe: I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:

verses.en: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
verses.pt: mas espero te ver em breve, e falaremos face a face. Paz seja contigo. Os amigos daqui te saúdam. Saúda os amigos daí, cada um por nome.
verses.en_web: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.en_bbe: But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face. May you have peace. Your friends here send you their love. Give my love to our friends by name.
